newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Maryland National Capital Park.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Maryland National Capital Park.

text.p: The Maryland-National Capital Park and Planning Commission

Park Acquisition and Development Bonds, Series T-2 NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that The Maryland-National Capital Park and Planning Commission (the Commission'') will receive written sealed bids for the $33,000,000 Prince George's County Park Acquisition and Development Bonds, Series T-2 (the Bonds'') until 11:00 a.m. local Baltimore, Maryland time on:

or the offices of Piper & Marbury L.L.P., Conference Room 2A, Second Floor, 36 S. Charles Street, Baltimore, Maryland, 21201. The Bonds will be dated January 15, 1997 and will mature on January 15th in the years 1998 through 2017 as more fully described in the Notice of Sale. The Bonds are subject to redemption as set forth in the Notice of Sale. No bid for less than all of the Bonds will be considered. The Bonds will be awarded based on the lowest interest cost to the Commission, determined in accordance with the true interest cost (TIC) method. All bids must be accompanied by a good faith deposit in the amount of $ 660,000

payable to the order of A. Edward Navarre, Secretary- Treasurer, The Maryland-National Capital Park and Planning Commission. Each bid must be on the official bid form relating to the Bonds and conform to the terms and
conditions set forth in the Notice of Sale.

Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement and the Notice of Sale and form of proposal relating to the Bonds may be obtained from the office of A, Edward Navarre, Secretary-Treasurer, The Maryland-National Capital Park and Planning Commission, 6611 Kenilworth Avenue, Riverdale, Maryland 20737, (301) 454-1540, Legg Mason Wood Walker, Inc., 111 South Calvert Street, Baltimore, Maryland 21202, (410) 539-0000, or from Pryor, McClendon, Counts & Co., Inc., 1100 Peachtree Street, Suite 1660, Atlanta, Georgia 30309 (404) 875-2161.
